events.reason: Drusus: new streets, new stories - I open district A.
Brutus: no blades worth crossing yet - I take district C first.
Cassia: the shortest leg first - district E sits one step from my gate.
Ana: no risks on the first day - I open district B beside my own gate.
Drusus: two districts left unsullied - I go south to D.
Brutus: last unknown ground - I clear district F before anyone else does.
Cassia: I chart the west column first - pilum at D, then north to A.
Ana: one careful step, one small knife - I buy low and sell never.
Drusus: a helmet for the road - the wandering life needs a galea.
Brutus: the wanderer outguns me - no duel. I fetch armor at E instead.
Cassia: column plan holds - pugio at A, then the eastern row.
Ana: steady margins - pilum now, the galea next door after.
Drusus: the east quarter calls - a scutum for my growing kit.
Brutus: ties favor the defender, so that fight is not even - pugio at A instead.
Cassia: east along the top - gladius at B, lorica at C after.
Ana: a helmet at my elbow - the safest bargain on the board.
Drusus: a short stride north - the barracks lorica is two steps on.
Brutus: one step, one sword - the gladius rounds out my kit.
Cassia: lorica at C, scutum at F, then the center - the loop closes.
Ana: a shield for cheap, one step away - I never pay extra for distance.
Drusus: the barracks sell armor to travelers - lorica secured.
Brutus: last piece - a pilum from D and I stand complete.
Cassia: scutum at F closes my set - the veteran beat me by one turn.
Ana: last item on my list - the lorica completes my inventory.
Drusus: one more souvenir - the gladius joins the road kit.
Brutus: full kit and the center in reach - I claim the checkpoint first.
Cassia: the transition clock runs - I bank Glory at the east post while it lasts.
Ana: a wager with no loss - I stand the east watch for coin.
Drusus: the west wall has the better view - I try my luck there.
Brutus: no even fights on offer - I angle toward the west post for more Glory.
Cassia: nearest post, same odds - I cap my Glory before the palace shifts.
Ana: step off, step back - the watch pays better than a duel.
Drusus: one more street before the palace turns over - south it is.
Brutus: one last watch - a soldier banks his pay before the war changes.
Cassia: position resets at the turn - I take the quiet step and wait.
Ana: last free chance at coin before the gates pull us home.
Drusus: the cellars first - I do love a good underground.
Brutus: the barracks guard is a soldier - that is a fair test.
Cassia: certainty beats odds - one Glory buys the peristyle seal outright.
Ana: I pay coin, not chance - the peristyle seal is mine.
Drusus: the old courtyard - luck rides with the curious.
Brutus: the guard beat me once - a veteran asks for the same fight again.
Cassia: cellars at four chances in six, one step - clear arithmetic.
Ana: the cellar odds favor me - four in six, one step, no duel.
Drusus: same stones, new dice - the courtyard owes me a seal.
Brutus: twice the guard threw sixes - I pay the peristyle toll instead.
Cassia: three steps short of the throne - I stage at the retreat.
Ana: a sure crown is worth a coin - I pay for the strong swing.
Drusus: third time at the courtyard stones - the road teaches patience.
Brutus: short stride west - the cellars open on my next march.
Cassia: the trader struck first - I cannot wait, I swing.
Ana: one more blow and the crown is sold - I swing where I stand.
Drusus: new door, new guard - the barracks this time.
Brutus: down to the cellars - a plain roll, no tricks.
Cassia: the winning blow is one roll away - I take it now.
